Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Is watching a bright screen (computer/TV) in the dark damaging to your eyes?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine your eyes are like little cameras that need just the right amount of light to see well.

If you look at a bright screen in a very dark room, your eyes have to work extra hard. The bright light from the screen can make your eyes tired, just like how it’s hard to look at a flashlight in a dark room.

But, it won’t break your eyes or make you go blind right away. However, if you do it a lot, your eyes might feel sore, get tired, or even start to hurt. That’s why it’s better to have some soft light in the room when you watch a screen.

So, it’s not super bad just once, but it’s not the best thing for your eyes if you do it all the time in the dark.
